requirement: Versioned `VehicleConfig` defines asset ID, component IDs, body frame, rotor positions/directions, SI units, measured/assumed values and uncertainties
acceptance: Schema rejects missing safety-critical geometry, invalid units and nonphysical mass/inertia; V01/V02

requirement: Assembly mass pipeline includes frame, motors, props, ESCs, battery, payload, fasteners and wiring
acceptance: Full CG and inertia retained through dynamics; mesh validity exposed; V02

requirement: Dataset manifest records source, permission/license, checksum, acquisition, calibration, splits and status
acceptance: Real-data run fails or returns NOT_SCORED if data are missing; V00

requirement: Separate raw sensors, onboard estimates, twin predictions, reference truth, command intent and applied actuation
acceptance: Test detects any truth-derived synthetic sensor entering a real score; V00/V05

requirement: Preserve acquisition/receive/simulation time and clock mapping uncertainty
acceptance: Reordering, lag and reset tests have deterministic outcomes; V04

requirement: Immutable raw logs; derived data records transformation version and parent hashes
acceptance: Same manifest and code reproduce the same processed dataset within declared platform tolerances

requirement: One tested rigid-body kernel serves twin prediction and RL/SITL wrappers
acceptance: Correct NED/FRD gravity and thrust; full inertia Euler equation; V01

requirement: Explicit actuator model maps applied motor command and voltage to RPM, thrust and reaction torque
acceptance: Measured delay/lag/saturation and rotor mapping; payload mass does not magically scale motor capability; V03

requirement: Propeller model offers measured-map baseline and BEMT with validity/convergence reporting
acceptance: Genuine matched UIUC/bench comparison; unsupported conditions fail visibly; V03

requirement: CFD produces traceable offline aerodynamic data
acceptance: Correct dimensions/reference quantities, mesh/time/iteration studies and independent benchmark; V08

requirement: Assembled frame model includes joints and installed masses with stated material limitations
acceptance: Static and modal correlation to manufactured article; V09

requirement: ECM/SOC/thermal pack model uses actual chemistry, topology and measured parameters
acceptance: Correct voltage field and pack scaling; independent pulse/flight profiles; V07

requirement: Energy forecast integrates electrical power over a declared future duty cycle or mission policy
acceptance: Separate retrospective and prospective evaluations; V11

requirement: Configuration trade tool compares payload, propeller, battery and arm/frame alternatives
acceptance: Uncertainty-aware feasible design comparison plus at least one physical confirmation; V12

requirement: Estimator uses documented specific-force, gravity, quaternion and magnetic-field equations
acceptance: Known-heading correction, IMU bias, innovation-gate and covariance tests; V01/V05

requirement: Reference truth is independent where claimed; correlated estimates are labelled as agreement, not truth
acceptance: Report schema lists reference instrument and uncertainty; V05

requirement: Only identifiable parameter subsets may update
acceptance: Rank/conditioning or excitation gate blocks unobservable mass/thrust separation; V06

requirement: Offline fitting precedes online adaptation; calibration/test split is by run/configuration
acceptance: No row-wise leakage from the same flight; fixed baseline retained; V06/V11

requirement: Candidate parameter versions are bounded, validated and promoted atomically
acceptance: Stale/faulted/OOD data freeze updates; rollback on failed holdout and divergence; V06/V10

requirement: Predictions carry uncertainty, method, interval level and applicability
acceptance: Calibration/coverage and interval width reported on holdout, with sample limitations

requirement: Unknown, stale, outside-domain and insufficient-excitation are first-class states
acceptance: Dashboard/report cannot render these as healthy green scores; V10

requirement: Residual-based condition flags are tested as hypotheses, not definitive fault diagnoses
acceptance: False alarms, missed detections and delay on labelled scenarios; no RUL without longitudinal evidence; V10

requirement: Deterministic CLI supports import, calibrate, replay, validate and report
acceptance: Clean-environment example returns artifact paths and meaningful exit codes

requirement: One real PX4/MAVLink integration replaces serialization-only dispatch claims
acceptance: Peer decodes messages; heartbeat/mode/setpoint handling proven in SITL; V13

requirement: Read-only/offline operation is default; experimental actuation is explicit opt-in
acceptance: No armed hardware command from default examples/tests; V10/V13

requirement: Safety gateway checks vehicle ID, finite/ranged values, frame, freshness and allowed state transitions
acceptance: Link loss/stale setpoint uses configured autopilot behaviour, never blindly disarms in flight; V13

requirement: Engineering cockpit shows physical estimate, prediction, aligned residual, forecast interval, domain and evidence level
acceptance: Every plot exposes units, time basis, source, asset and model version

requirement: Single command exports a professional benchmark/design-review report
acceptance: Figures include conditions, uncertainty, counts, failures and reproducibility command

requirement: README and metadata distinguish implemented, tested, calibrated and validated capabilities
acceptance: Remove static production claims and unsupported performance/compatibility labels

requirement: Tagged release includes technical report, data manifest, environment, licensing and contribution record
acceptance: External reader can inspect and reproduce the central claim
